## Clip Engine 0.12.2

Pro and Ultra are open.

- **Subscribe from the app.** Settings > Plan has working Subscribe buttons for Pro ($2.99 a month) and Ultra ($4.99 a month). Polar emails your license key: paste it in the same card.
- **Special keys** from 0.12.1 work as before.

Download `Clip_Engine-windows-x64.zip`, unzip it anywhere and run `ClipEngine.exe`. If you already have Clip Engine, update from Settings.
